workflow.place.gates.title: Gates
workflow.place.gates.body: The checks the line declares, accepted once for everything they serve: verifying the work that lands and integrating it.
workflow.place.gates.nothing: No gates here ask for your acceptance: the work that lands names no verification, and the line declares no integration.
workflow.place.gates.summary.none: Nothing here asks for your acceptance
workflow.place.discard.label: Replace the steps you are editing
workflow.place.discard.says: Change… replaces the editor. The changes you have made to these steps are not saved and cannot be got back.
workflow.place.change.title: Change what its work follows
workflow.place.change.body: Select a workflow to see it drawn, then use it for {{route}}. A preset is saved as a copy first.
workflow.place.change.pick: Select one to see it drawn here.
workflow.place.change.noGraph: This preset has no steps to draw.
workflow.place.change.steps: This version is made of steps, which the chart draws once it is chosen.
workflow.place.change.chosen: Chosen. New work here follows it; running work keeps the version it started with.
workflow.place.change.copy.name: Name of the copy
workflow.place.change.own: {{place}} follows a workflow of its own for {{route}}; the workspace's applies where it follows none.
workflow.place.change.currentLive: Follows its old landing rule, read as the rule stands.
workflow.place.change.savedNone: No workflow is saved here yet.
workflow.place.ask.fill: I have {{place}}'s workflow open in the editor, and I want to change it:
workflow.place.steps.title: Its steps
workflow.place.steps.body: Edit a version's steps in the editor, judged as you go. Saved, a version is chosen here and running work keeps the one it started under.
workflow.place.repositories.summary: {{count}} repository, {{own}} with rules of its own
workflow.place.repositories.summary_othe: {{count}} repositories, {{own}} with rules of their own
workflow.place.chart.older: This driver does not draw a route's graph yet, so the chart waits for it.
workflow.place.chart.landedNone: Landed work follows no verification here, so there is no chart to draw.
workflow.place.chart.problem.noVersion: `{{workflow}}` keeps no version that reads here.
workflow.place.chart.problem.pullRequest: `{{workflow}}` v{{version}}'s step `{{step}}` is a pull request of the plugin `{{plugin}}`, which is not installed here, is switched off, contributes nothing or performs no steps, so no run starts on it. The Plugins place says what there is.
